Messages.Author: Chris Hoffman
Messages.Body:
I need a clarification on Protected Resources.

"If this card is in play, another Methuselah cannot bleed you for more than
2 pool."

If the condition of the card is not met:

"Burn this card if you successfully bleed another Methuselah."

how far does the first statement go. Does it mean that another Methuselah
cannot bleed me for more than two PERIOD? Does it mean that another
Methuselah cannoth bleed me for more than two in a round? Or does it mean
that another Methuselah cannot bleed me for more than two per vampire?

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:


Per action.

It means that each bleed action against you will be limited to two.
This limit is applied at the time you burn your pool.
